room_description: A rustic wooden cabin or office room featuring a desk, bookshelf, a vintage globe, a small safe, plants, and puzzle panels integrated into the floor and walls.

key_moments.description: Establishing shot of the wooden office room.
Inspects the metal dot puzzle integrated into the wooden floor.
Checks the desk and moves magazines to reveal the equation 'Z=Y-X'.
Examines a glowing sun puzzle panel mounted on the wall.
Solves the floor dot puzzle by recreating a specific pattern, turning dots gold.
Collects a wooden ruler from the newly opened floor compartment.
Uses the ruler on the chalkboard to measure the sides of a drawn triangle.
Weighs a black ball on the red scale to determine its numerical value.
Enters the calculated 3-digit code into the desk drawer lock.
Retrieves the door key from the unlocked drawer.

solution_steps: Observe the pattern from the other wall grids.
Press the corresponding metal dots on the floor panel until they turn gold to match the pattern.
Find the correct sequence of four symbols (Magnet, Telescope, Lightbulb, Magnifying Glass).
Input the symbols into the four square panels on the cabinet.
Use the ruler on the chalkboard to find the value of Y.
Weigh the black ball on the scale to find the value of X.
Calculate Z using the desk formula 'Z=Y-X'.
Enter the resulting 3-digit combination into the drawer.

final_action: Uses the acquired key to unlock the main wooden door and escape the room.
